'''Proop''' were edible slugs native to the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of [[Chad/Legends|Chad]], where they traveled in herds. They were tentacled creatures that grew to about fifteen [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long. They were semi-domesticated and tended to stay in the warmer upper levels of the ocean.<ref name="AJ10" />
